sections.heading: String interpolation
sections.after_text: Note: `${...}` is scanned as an expression, so nested strings may use the same quote as the outer template.

sections.heading: Common methods
sections.markdown:
- `len(s)` counts Unicode scalars; `len(s.bytes())` counts UTF-8 bytes
- `s.startsWith(prefix)` / `s.endsWith(suffix)`
- `s.indexOf(sub)` / `s.contains(sub)`
- `s.slice(start, end)` / `s.split(sep)` / `s.replace(old, new)`
